change:
Widen the assisted glide entry band and make the support wheels follow it.

1. ASSISTED_BRIDGE_STARTS[glide] speed_range (.45,.58) -> (.50,.76). The old band
   sat entirely below the speed at which a 2.0 s credible glide is reachable for
   this body. Sweeping the injected speed over the frozen model_9499 policy
   (local/probe-glide-entry-speed.py) locates that boundary: entry 0.62 m/s never
   reaches 2.0 s, entry 0.685 m/s does, and 2.0 s glides appear for the first time
   (1/64 at injection 0.72, 2/64 at 0.78).

2. reset_credit_bridge_spawn gains wheel_speed_follow (default False, so every
   other assisted stage keeps byte-identical behaviour). When set, the two SUPPORT
   wheels spin at v/r of the sampled speed instead of the value recorded at 0.51
   m/s. The recorded value implies 0.55 m/s and contradicts any other injected
   speed inside the actor own observation. Measured on the same frozen policy,
   injecting 0.58 -> 0.78 m/s: the entry speed the policy settles at moves
   0.526 -> 0.580 m/s with the recorded wheels and 0.558 -> 0.742 m/s with them
   following. Without this, widening the band alone would have bought almost
   nothing. The two UNLOADED swing wheels stay at their recorded near-still
   values, because a wheel in mid-air does not roll with the ground.

Reward terms are unchanged (reward_terms_before == after). No actor file is

untouched. mdp.py is unchanged by this record. Diagnosed from the trace that at
every injected speed 51-59 of 64 episodes reach the 3.4 s horizon, so the glide
